reviews.review:
I played the original game, and I don't remember it being so buggy.

First, the graphics are better and worse. There is *less* portraits than in the old original. The overall quality of the graphics is better. Skills and everything look the same. Refreshed my original memories.

Too bad I can't make a positive review as I just lost 25 hours of gameplay, because we have ONE save that is automatically overwritten. I had a quest to defeat 4 NPCs, and Captured the 4th. Guess what - now I can't proceed the Story quest and it says to "inform the other NPC" but nope, there is no option in the place where the NPCs are.  Guess being so cheap to as to offer one single save with it having gamebreaking bugs sucks. And with the sheer amount of things to do (defeating enemies, sieging cities, capturing enemies, crafting items, training mounts, learning enemy skills) the option to lose all progress due to a random bug is laughable.

Stay away from this garbage, it will just waste your time.
